title: 무너진 천구를 떠받치는 부단장
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Output: ONE SINGLE landscape about3:2 ASTELLA boss key-scene illustration, not an asset sheet. Match the provided actual actor's HUMAN identity, polished stylized 2D anime fantasy game art, broad clean color shapes, restrained texture, ivory/navy/warm-gold palette. Dramatic cinematic lighting but clear readable silhouette and natural connected anatomy. No photoreal metal, no gritty texture, no gore, no sexualization. ONE dominant boss with full or nearly full major silhouette in a fitting emotional arena; all major weapon shapes inside frame. No UI, subtitles, title text, labels, watermarks, panels, turnaround, Tpose, equipment layout or extra solid bosses.
Input image: actor identity and costume reference ONLY. Preserve same lean clean-shaven adult vice-captain: long pale lavender/silver hair gathered into low flowing tail, lavender eyes, one fine GOLD MONOCLE at actor's LEFT eye, navy-and-ivory military command coat with gold star trim, epaulettes, high black collar, white trousers, navy gold-trimmed boots. He is NOT the older bearded captain. Keep face recognizable; madness is a strained anguished protective expression, not a faceless skull/machine.
Scene:45m circular black-obsidian STAR-CHART arena under frozen midnight cosmos, immense coherent brass astrolabe rings behind him. A single colossal broken CELESTIAL ARC bows down diagonally from high background and visibly presses across his shoulder/back like the crushing weight of a fallen firmament. Floor clock-hour engravings I-IV are shattered/unlit, V-XII glow cool blue in the environment, not typography overlay. Do not clutter with tiny gears.
Composition/pose: low three-quarter camera, boss large center-left, nearly full kneeling/braced silhouette, one knee on cracked obsidian and other boot planted. Shoulder line visibly compressed under celestial arc, long coat tails and pale hair sweep along floor. His colossal GOLD HOUR-HAND SPEAR is fully visible diagonally upright across right half: butt firmly planted in foreground, large stylized clock-hand blade supporting the heavy celestial arc high above shoulder. Weapon retains the reference broad ivory/gold angular spearhead with navy cutout accents; not a generic lance.
EXACTLY TWO connected arms and TWO gloved hands. His right arm is tense and thrusts forward while gripping planted spear shaft. His left forearm crosses over his chest and LEFT HAND clearly clamps HIS OWN RIGHT FOREARM immediately above wrist, restraining the attack impulse as an unconscious bodily act of shielding absent subordinates. Make both shoulders, elbows, wrists and grip connections legible, no third hand, no detached limbs. Spear and shoulder carry weight, left hand restrains own weapon arm, not a wound. Purple corruption ribbons and a restrained cold blue glow around coat seams suggest war-wraith madness without replacing human face. Emotional contrast: furious/crazed eyes yet protective restrained gesture. Warm ivory/gold boss against cold black/navy cosmic arena, a few large fallen star-map fragments only, no other characters.

references.role: exact actor identity and costume reference, seen with view_image

notes: Recognizable human vice-captain: long pale lavender/silver hair, monocle, slender clean-shaven adult face, navy/ivory/gold military costume
Kneeling under collapsing coherent celestial arc; planted hour-hand spear is fully inside frame after revision
Exactly two arms/hands read as connected; one hand restrains own weapon forearm; no self-injury gore
Cold black/navy star-chart arena, large astrolabe rings and blue/dark floor markers support scenario
Clean stylized2D illustration, one dominant boss, no UI/turnaround/equipment sheet
limitations: In-world clock/star markings are illustrative rather than measured scene-layout geometry
